Huangfu confirmation results: independent audit, 7 November 2026

VERDICT
All runs completed and the computational gains remain intact at the tested
scoring stage. The proposed signed-activity correction is not yet confirmed as
an improvement for the shipped native RustScenic scorer. The prespecified
shared-scorer result improves, but the native-scorer result does not.
Do not publish an equal-biological-accuracy or universally improved-fix claim.

PROVENANCE AND EXECUTION
Slack return: Huangfu, 7 November 2026, 16:18:09 GMT.
https://huang-lab-omics.slack.com/archives/C0BUGTD3F9C/p1794068289645369
Archive: SEND_BACK.tar.gz, Slack file F0CGMHR2HKJ.
SHA-256: ca67130354dd4e852f0c654f304e3aeddb7dfcd53748bae7c85aa3716c3ecd27
The supplied checksum matches. All 228 return-manifest files match; all 25
returned package files match the frozen package. Six biology tasks and twelve
atlas-scoring tasks completed successfully, with no missing tasks or failed
classifier convergence. All tasks use the expected package fingerprint.
Original HDMA input checksum and external input identities match. The ten
runtime versions and the native binary hash match the audited environment.
Within each atlas seed, all four measurements used the same host and 16 CPUs.
All sampled live-process PSS readings were complete.

INDEPENDENT SCIENTIFIC CHECKS
Verified 776 classifier-fold metrics directly from their confusion matrices,
including controls; checked donor-specific class counts against the original
metadata and training/test cell totals. Verified all 36 returned biological
score matrices for cell alignment, unique axes and finite values. Verified all
twelve 10,000-cell atlas sample matrices and raw memory traces. Five local
classifier refits reproduced the returned confusion matrices exactly for the
diagnostic seed 778 / patient_1244, across both scorers and the reference.
No network was refitted and no new method parameters were selected.

PRIMARY BIOLOGY: 20,000-CELL TRAINING NETWORKS
Evaluation cohort: 12,315 independent Kang2018 control PBMCs, eight donors.
Three inference seeds, averaged within donor before paired donor bootstrap.
These are cell-type classification macro-F1 scores, not percentages of correct
regulatory edges. Matched common TFs: 14, 21 and 20 across the three seeds.

Endpoint                                  Before       After
Rust networks, shared reference scorer    0.673762     0.692902
Rust networks, native Rust scorer         0.690106     0.682918
SCENIC+ networks, reference scorer        0.711326     0.711326

Shared-scorer correction: +1.914 percentage points; paired donor bootstrap
95% interval +0.373 to +3.723 points. Six of eight donors improve. The remaining
gap to the matched reference is -1.842 points, interval -3.446 to -0.295.
Thus the shared-scorer gap is approximately halved, not eliminated.

Native-scorer correction: -0.719 points; interval -3.082 to +1.233.
This is not evidence of an improvement. The interval includes zero, so it also
does not establish a reliable population-wide deterioration. Four donors
improve and four decline. Corrected native Rust remains -2.841 points below
the reference, interval -5.173 to -0.884.

Balanced accuracy also does not establish a consistent correction benefit:
the shared-scorer change is +1.189 points, interval -1.951 to +5.227.
The 5,000-cell sensitivity result is similarly inconclusive for improvement:
shared macro-F1 0.599572 to 0.606795, native 0.608949 to 0.601687. Both correction
intervals include zero; both corrected matched endpoints trail the reference.

WHERE THE CHANGE OCCURS
Shared-scorer megakaryocyte F1 rises from 0.4481 to 0.6905. This accounts for
most of the overall shared-scorer gain; several other classes decline.
Native megakaryocyte F1 instead changes from 0.5238 to 0.5090. Native changes
also include CD8 T cells -2.45 points and FCGR3A+ monocytes -2.99 points, while
B-cell F1 improves by 1.05 points. See primary-class-summary.csv for every class.
These are diagnostic per-class averages, not a newly selected primary endpoint.

Native and shared AUCell scores are not numerically interchangeable. Across
the primary matched signed features, per-TF Pearson correlations range from
0.737 to 0.990. This identifies a scorer/representation interaction worth
investigating; it does not yet establish whether ranking, tie handling,
normalisation or another implementation detail causes the difference.

BIOLOGICAL CONTROLS AND LIMITS
At the fixed seed777/20,000-cell comparison, the actual shared-scorer Rust
macro-F1 is 0.6906, versus 0.3519-0.4067 for five size/coverage-matched random
gene sets and 0.0944-0.1520 for ten training-label permutations.
The reference also exceeds its controls: 0.7170 versus random 0.3147-0.3508
and shuffled-label 0.0498-0.1764. This supports non-random cell-type information.
Expression PCA50 scores 0.8841, so network activity is not the strongest
cell-type classifier tested. That baseline answers a different feature task.
SPI1 monocyte enrichment is strong (mean AUROC about 0.981 for signed Rust).
PAX5, EBF1 and TCF7 are absent from the scored networks, so those planned
marker checks provide no validation. Do not count absence as a successful test.
The all-TF shared-scorer Rust endpoint reaches 0.8156, but has 152-157 features
against 14-22 in the reference. It is a secondary, unequal-capacity comparison
and must not replace the matched primary result.
This RNA transfer cohort does not validate causal edges or enhancer links.

ATLAS SCORING COST: 817,740 REAL CELLS, THREE SEEDS, 16 CPUS
Median for RustScenic                     Before       After
Scoring stage including input/output     58.538 s     57.798 s
Whole measured child process             62.263 s     61.055 s
Peak process-tree PSS                     568.573 MB   638.440 MB

There is no material runtime penalty in these runs. Median peak measured
memory is 69.868 MB higher (12.3% for this small scoring-stage footprint).
Memory varies across seeds and the before/after ranges overlap; three seeds
do not justify an exact universal overhead claim.
The corrected reference scoring stage takes 852.161 s with 1,207.027 MB PSS.
The observed scoring-stage ratio is 14.74x and PSS is 47.1% lower for Rust.
These are NOT new full-pipeline SCENIC+ results. Each method scores its own
frozen networks (Rust 66-67 TF outputs; reference 5-6), so do not market this
as a matched-signature scorer-only benchmark either. The paired within-Rust
before/after comparison is the intended performance confirmation here.
Original full-pipeline comparisons remain separate evidence. No inference,
topic fitting or motif step was rerun or changed by this package.

REMAINING ACTION
Keep the candidate correction experimental. Diagnose the native/shared AUCell
difference locally using the returned matrices and frozen inputs, especially
the rare-cell effect. Establish a principled implementation correction and
regression checks before another confirmation request. Do not tune against
this now-inspected external cohort and then call it independent validation.
The present results support efficiency and some biological usefulness, not
biological equivalence. Manuscript claims must reflect that distinction.

Full atlas score matrices remain on HPC as planned. Their recorded hashes and
shape summaries were checked, and returned samples were inspected; the omitted
full matrices were not independently read locally.
Nothing was sent, published, uploaded or changed in the repository during this
audit. No new package was sent to Huangfu.

FILES
verified-results.json: verified endpoint statistics and paired intervals.
integrity-audit.json: archive, package and task checksum verification.
verified-performance.csv: raw-trace-verified measurements.
primary-class-summary.csv: isolated endpoint-only per-class comparisons.
scorer-differences.csv: matched native/reference scoring differences.
audit_results.py and audit.log: independent verification procedure and outcome.
